# Context for <repo name>

Deep reference pages, read when a task needs them. `AGENTS.md` is the short always-read file and links here.
Status and readiness: run `node .ai-kit/context-tools.cjs readiness`.

| Page | Covers |
| --- | --- |
| [architecture.md](architecture.md) | Modules, request flow, integrations, why |
| [domain.md](domain.md) | Glossary, capabilities, business rules not yet in specs |
| [screens.md](screens.md) | (UI repos) screens, user flows, field mapping |
| [data.md](data.md) | Stores, main tables, how flows read and write data, migrations |
| [data/index.md](data/index.md) | One page per table (generated structure, written meaning) |
| [api.md](api.md) | Endpoints provided and called, conventions, consumers |
| [dependencies.md](dependencies.md) | Libraries, services and infrastructure, who depends on this |
| [security.md](security.md) | Authentication, authorisation, sensitive data, rules |
| [testing.md](testing.md) | Commands, layers, test data, gaps |
| [operations.md](operations.md) | Environments, config, deployment, jobs, logs, failures |
| [decisions/](decisions/) | Why things are the way they are |
| [areas/](areas/) | Deep pages for complex areas, added as stories need them |
| [known-traps.md](known-traps.md) | Things that look wrong but are deliberate |
| [readiness.md](readiness.md) | Latest readiness assessment |
